## Julia Slack

Want to bring your package into JuliaBayes, suggest a collaboration, or talk Bayes?
Come say hello in [`#bayes`](https://julialang.slack.com/archives/C0BKRUEN6CX) on the Julia Slack.
If you are not on the Julia Slack yet, [join here](https://julialang.org/slack/).

## GitHub

For questions or bug reports about a package, open an issue in its repository under [JuliaBayes](https://github.com/JuliaBayes).
For this website, [open an issue in the website repository](https://github.com/JuliaBayes/juliabayes.github.io/issues).
